text:
carmen: Hey @runtime-team @infra-team @security-team — quick sync on PR #43921. This touches the eviction fallback and KMS config. Need runtime perf signoff, infra IAM/network check, security KMS review, and platform for canary timing. Hoping to merge in Monday slot (see below).

PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/43921
TL;DR: prefer pinned LRU in eviction fallback, add optional KMS key config, and new env var REDWOOD_ROTATE_KEYS (opt-in). Touches hot-path cache path so want extra eyes.

Local perf command:```
./scripts/bench --model gpt-medium --seq 1024 --iters 100
```

Runtime: @kevin_j @maya — can you run perf + quick code skim?
Infra: @samir — need IAM/network signoff for adding KMS ARN to config and migration doc.
Security: @sasha — quick KMS policy + rotation check.
Platform: @alexa — can you reserve a canary slot? Prefer Monday 10:00 PST.
Thanks! :pray:

kevin_j: I'll run the bench now and post numbers by EOD tomorrow. Quick q: does this change increase KV cache metadata or just reorder eviction? If metadata increases we need to watch mem.

maya: skimmed the diff — code looks clean. Please add a small unit test for tie-breaker logic in eviction. Otherwise low risk.

samir: IAM note: adding plaintext KMS ARN to config is fine, but we need a migration doc and a note for ops about key policy. Network unaffected. Assigning infra-ci to run gating tests.

sasha: I'll do a security pass tomorrow morning. Need an example KMS policy/ARN and confirmation rotation isn't forced on existing keys by default. Also check logging for rotations.

alexa: Monday 10:00 PST usually ok but our calendar is tight that week. If you can do Monday that's preferred over Friday. If Monday is impossible we can carve 30m on Fri 15:00 PST. Need named canary owners (ops/rt) to be listed in the PR.

carmen: Monday 10:00 PST works for our team. I'll add the migration doc and example policy snippet to the PR, and tag canary owners.

kevin_j: ran bench quickly — baseline p50 12.3ms, branch p50 13.1ms, p99 ~ unchanged. CPU tick up ~4%. Full logs uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/bench/43921/logs.txt

deploy-bot: merge window check: Monday 10:00 PST slot available and tentatively reserved by @alexa. Reminder: add label `canary:mon-10am` and include post-canary rollback plan before merge.

sasha: security quick-pass done — one small item: validate KMS ARN format client-side and fail fast with clear error. Also add a line to the migration doc about required KMS key policyACLs. Otherwise +1 after that fix.

maya: added the unit test in latest commit and updated one assertion. LGTM from me once CI passes. :heavy_check_mark:

samir: infra signoff queued; will re-check after integration tests finish in staging. If staging green, infra +1.

carmen: thanks everyone — I'll add client-side validation and the policy snippet, tag PR with `canary:mon-10am`, and set the merge target for Monday 10:00 PST. If anyone can't cover canary, please reply here.

alexa: ack — I'll be on the call Monday and ops-rt has been cc'd in the PR.

(End of thread)
